sources.title: Replicas Workspaces
sources.locator: Tools; chats; collaboration; sleep and archive
sources.finding: Per-workspace Linux VM; multiple harness chats; queued/steering messages; shared workspaces; file editor/diffs/inline comments, Linux desktop, terminal, Docker and Canvas. Sleep after 30 minutes inactivity, message wakes/restores; retention/deletion deadlines apply.

sources.title: Replicas Motherships
sources.finding: Long-lived orchestrator delegates separate-VM ships, sends messages and receives results, tracks ships/PRs/Linear/blockers/decisions. Cap20 unarchived ships; ships cannot spawn ships; unavailable in Cursor chats. Shared teammates run it together.

sources.title: Replicas Automations
sources.finding: Saved prompts run on schedules or GitHub/GitLab/Slack/Sentry/Linear/custom webhooks. Fresh or reused workspace, debounce and successful-run limit; delete/archive/sleep policies; delete waits for background work.

sources.title: Replicas Desktop app
sources.finding: macOS12 Intel/Arm, Windows10+ and Linux AppImage/deb x64/Arm. Native window wraps hosted deployment; mac notifications/screenshots; experimental local port forwarding.

sources.title: Replicas iOS app
sources.finding: Native iOS starts cloud tasks and queues followups, reviews changes/checks/Canvas. Cloud work continues when app closes; no file browser/Code/Desktop tab. Consent before AI data sharing.

sources.title: Replicas Team
sources.finding: Admin/Member/custom roles with additive All members grants; environment/automation Read/Write and analytics Read. Removed users immediately lose organization workspaces.

sources.title: Replicas Billing
sources.finding: Developer$50/month includes$50 usage; Team$200+ in$100 steps, seats do not change bill. $100 trial credit no card/no time limit; exhausted trial blocked until paid. Compute rates, monthly rollover reset, daily overage invoices and hard usage limit documented.

sources.title: Replicas Security policies
sources.finding: Require Replicas/code-host identity and PR user attribution; block agent PR/MR merges and default protected branch pushes.

sources.title: Replicas Data retention
sources.finding: History setting retains chat/Canvas asleep/archived when enabled, awake-only when disabled; repository files separate. Available trial/Team/Enterprise, not Developer.

sources.title: Replicas Review
sources.finding: PR/MR queue, guided tour ordered diffs, agent review chat, inline comments/review/agent-fix options; approve/request changes/merge subject to repository rules.

sources.title: Replicas Learnings
sources.finding: Org skills loaded into new/resumed workspaces. Suggested persistent instructions require save; nightly recurring-instruction extraction also saves/merges learnings with audit trail. Everyone can manage; Agent Memory toggle disables.

sources.title: Replicas Plan mode
sources.finding: Claude/Codex plan sidebar with Markdown download and selection comments; Cursor plan stays in chat.

sources.title: Replicas Codex
sources.finding: Native Codex with ChatGPT subscription, own API key or compatible provider; personal/org credentials, context across sleep, compact command; capacity retry five times over about two minutes.

sources.title: Replicas CLI
sources.finding: Product CLI creates and controls workspaces, agent authentication, shell/services/computer use.

sources.title: Replicas API
sources.finding: Versioned bearer-token REST API creates/messages/shares workspaces and manages automations; API-created workspaces delete when done by default unless lifecycle overridden; read never wakes.

sources.title: Replicas MCP server
sources.finding: Hosted MCP exposes workspace/chat/environment/repository/automation/learning controls with same API permissions; OAuth creates revocable personal key.

sources.title: Replicas Environments
sources.finding: Team/personal inherited environments supply variables/files/skills/MCP/plugins. Warm pools/hooks and start hooks. Read allows launching, Write editing; workspace agent gets owner access; Codex provisioned MCP auto-approves inside VM.

sources.title: Replicas Quickstart
sources.finding: Replicas account, own subscription/API credentials, GitHub/GitLab connection and environment, then send task; Claude/Codex subscription connection CLI.

sources.title: Replicas Audit log
sources.finding: Admin-only configuration audit with actor/time/before-after JSON, secrets redacted; append-only, indefinitely retained with no delete UI.

sources.title: Replicas Analytics
sources.finding: Compute minutes, source, PRs/merge rate and per-seat activity; time ranges and drilldowns. Model provider costs are separate.

sources.title: Replicas Changelog
sources.finding: Current weekly releases include shipped Motherships for all organizations, chat tabs/harness switching and Appshots.

sources.title: Replicas Enterprise
sources.finding: Enterprise offers platform self-hosted in own infrastructure or dedicated single-tenant; SCIM provisioning, audit and retention. Vendor claims SOC2 TypeI; TypeII in progress, not complete.

sources.title: Replicas Privacy
